{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Exclude refunded orders — only completed orders should count as conversions
completed_only = loyal_df[loyal_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the number of completed loyal customers and number who converted
n_completed = len(completed_only)
n_converted = completed_only['converted'].sum()

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_completed

# Print the values used in evidence
print("Number of completed loyal customers:", n_completed)
print("Number of converted completed loyal customers:", n_converted)
print("Conversion rate:", conversion_rate)"}
